“对了老弟，还有件事，等你突破鬼卒境之后，记得再来一趟这里。三等鬼差突破到鬼卒境，就可以晋升为二等阴差了，这样你才可以接取怨灵级以上的任务。”

顿了顿，朱宏又笑着补充：“等你攒够功绩了，就可以升为一等鬼差了，真成了一等鬼差，能拿到的好处，地府给你的权限，都会更大。”

吴姜眼睛瞬间亮了，能升职加薪，他自然是求之不得，连忙点头应下：“放心吧朱大哥，我一定过来！”

两人又闲聊了几句，吴姜突然想到了什么，好奇的问道：“对了，朱大哥，像我这样的阳间鬼差，地府多吗？”

朱宏斜楞了吴姜一眼，“你当我们这的鬼差是大白菜啊？现在只有一些道士兼职着地府的鬼差，还有一些就是代代相传的鬼差家族，加起来，也就几百个吧！”

吴姜刚想说，那也不少啊，可是一想到阳间的人口，又立马闭嘴了。

朱宏又叮嘱了他几句注意安全，以后的任务会越来越难。吴姜道谢后，这才返回了阳间。

他已经迫不及待的享受自己金手指带来的福利了。

果然，随着阴魂稳稳融入肉身的瞬间，还没等他缓过神来，一股熟悉的温热暖流，就顺着四肢百骸涌了进来。

“就是现在！”吴姜心中一喜，没有丝毫犹豫，立马盘腿坐直，双目微阖，彻底沉下心神，专心致志地引导着体内汹涌的魂力，朝着鬼卒境的瓶颈全力冲击。

他默默运转《幽冥炼魂诀》，口诀在心底飞速流转，体内的魂力瞬间变得狂暴起来。

胸前的聚灵吊坠也随之亮起淡淡的柔光，温润的灵气源源不断地渗入体内，辅助他冲击瓶颈。

"By the way, brother, there's one more thing. After you break through the Ghost Soldier Realm, remember to come here again. Once a third-level ghost has broken through to the Ghost Soldier Realm, you can be promoted to a second-class Yinshi, so that you can take on tasks above the Wraith Level."

After a pause, Zhu Hong added with a smile: "When you accumulate enough merit, you can be promoted to a first-class ghost servant. If you become a first-class ghost servant, the benefits you can get and the authority given to you by the underworld will be greater."

Wu Jiang's eyes lit up instantly. He naturally wanted to get a promotion and a salary increase. He nodded quickly and said, "Don't worry, Brother Zhu, I will definitely come!"

The two chatted for a while, and Wu Jiang suddenly thought of something and asked curiously: "By the way, Brother Zhu, are there many ghosts like me in the underworld?"

Zhu Hong gave Wu Jiang a sideways look, "Do you think our ghost servants are nothing? Now there are only some Taoist priests who work part-time as ghost servants in the underworld, and some are ghost servants who have been passed down from generation to generation. In total, there are only a few hundred!"

Wu Jianggang wanted to say, that's not a lot, but when he thought of the population of the underworld, he immediately shut up.

Zhu Hong told him a few more words to pay attention to safety, as future tasks would become increasingly difficult.After Wu Jiang thanked him, he returned to the underworld.

He couldn't wait to enjoy the benefits brought by his golden finger.

Sure enough, as the ghost was firmly integrated into the body, before he could recover, a familiar warm current surged in along his limbs.

"Now!" Wu Jiang was overjoyed, and without any hesitation, he immediately sat up straight with his legs crossed, his eyes slightly closed, his mind completely calmed, and he concentrated on guiding the surging soul power in his body to attack the bottleneck of the Ghost Soldier Realm with all his strength.

He silently ran the "Netherworld Soul Refining Technique", the formula circulated rapidly in his heart, and the soul power in his body instantly became violent.

The Spirit-Gathering Pendant on his chest also lit up with a soft light, and the warm spiritual energy continuously seeped into his body, assisting him in breaking through the bottleneck.
